_comment: Which of mxm-mono-03's parameters fill the collection's control roles.
Roles come from docs/MXM_CONTROL_MAP.md, which is normative; parameters are named by
their permanent string id, never by display name.
ACCENT IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT, and it is the one control a player would want here.
The collection standard is compiled into the player, and an instrument map naming a role
the player's standard does not declare is refused WHOLE - not just that entry. So claiming
an accent role would cost this instrument every mapping below on any player built before
the role existed. Accent stays reachable from the panel, from host automation, and from a
host's per-step modulation, which is how a sequencer reaches it anyway.
The roles now exist in the standard. This file claims them once an unknown role is inert
rather than fatal - see docs/MXM_CONTROL_MAP.md section 9.
filter.env_amount names the (Cutoff <- Filter envelope) route's amount, which the init patch
wires at zero above the circuit's Env Mod floor, so the knob is live on a fresh instance.
